Pakistan Real Estate Buying Guide 2026:
- Always verify NOC and Title deed from society.
- Best ROI locations: DHA Phase 6 and Clifton (12-15% yearly appreciation).
- For rental income: Bahria Town gives 8% yield.
- Most demanded: 3 bedrooms, 1200-1800 sqft.
- Always pay token money with written agreement.

Investment Tips 2026:
- Best time to buy is Nov-Feb when market is slow.
- Avoid properties older than 20 years without renovation.
- DHA Phase 8 has future growth due to new infrastructure.
- Furnished properties get 20% higher rent.

Legal Documents Required:
- Title deed, Allotment letter, NOC from society, Tax clearance certificate.
- Fees: Stamp duty 3%, CVT 2% in Sindh.
- For loan: Need salary slip 6 months, bank statement.
